WebAssembly C and C++ toolchain

The clang and lld WebAssembly executables, memfs, sysroot.tar and shared.js
come from the WebAssembly Community Group demonstration
https://github.com/binji/wasm-clang/tree/648c4a89997a351eef75cdaec3ef5b89d4937dec .
The five *.gz.b64.txt files contain base64-encoded gzip data.

Copyright 2020 WebAssembly Community Group participants.
The demonstration is distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(LICENSE). LLVM, Clang, LLD and libc++ license texts are in LICENSE.llvm.
The sysroot also contains WASI libc, musl and their dependencies. See the
accompanying wasi license and copyright files. Its dlmalloc component is
by Doug Lea and was released to the public domain under CC0 1.0.

support.js is the demonstration's shared.js with API.MemFS, API.App and
API.Tar exported for a separate in-memory compiler and test-case host.
The compiler, linker, memfs binary and sysroot archive are unmodified.
